description: Create a priced Checkout Session, read it back, then create a zero-total one.
note: 2023-08-16 enabled no-cost orders for one-time payments in Checkout, and the detail page puts the break in a subordinate clause: the change moves payment_method_collection from always to if_required. Nothing in the schema changes. The zero-total create is the second half of the same entry — rejected outright on 2022-11-15, accepted on basil — and both halves are readable without completing a session, which is what keeps this scenario independent of M5's hosted-page blocker (docs/m6-m8-probe.md).

steps.note: The observable: payment_method_collection is always on A and if_required on basil, with no request-side value to explain it.
What an integration reads when the shopper returns from the hosted page.
Last on purpose: it is a 400 on A, so nothing may reference its id. On basil the session exists with amount_total 0 and payment_intent null.
